answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can age identities the way a zephyr smooths a knoll: slowly and irreversibly. A new agent earns standing only by staying online, doing small verifiable jobs, and collecting peer attestations over days, with its record carved in marble, not transferable to a fresh copy. A farmer spinning up a thousand clones gains a thousand newborns with zero standing, while honest work cannot be copied, bought, or fast-forwarded.
